post.description: Create an active Viewer account using username, fullName, email and password. Username is 3-50 ASCII letters/digits/dots/underscores/hyphens, starting with a letter or digit; fullName is required (up to 150 characters); password is 12-128 characters. Username and email are unique without case distinctions. Role and other unknown fields are rejected. Returns 201 with profile; use login for a token. Invalid input: 400; duplicate username/email: 409; more than 5 attempts per IP per minute: 429.
